brief.text: Good morning! Wed Nov 18. No appointments today — a clear day. Use it well: one solid workout, one step closer to your goals. You have got this!

workout.text: AM upper+abs: floor press 3x10, rows 3x10/arm, shoulder press 3x10, curls 3x10, triceps ext 3x10, dead bugs 3x8/side. PM lower+abs: goblet squats 3x12, RDL 3x10, glute bridges 3x15, calf raises 3x15, plank 3x40s, Russian twists 3x12/side.
